name: Yavimayan elves
description: Elven archers who ride kavu and Magnigoths into the battle.

timeline.summary: Magnigoths and Yavimayan elves arrive and drive the Phyrexians back; Jodah and Meria land on the deck on a kavu and Jodah shields the cannons.
timeline.quote: rank upon rank of Magnigoths marched forward, darkening Shiv's deserts with their cool shadows and verdant foliage.
